verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs say subscription changes (plan, price, quantity, add-ons) come with control over timing, proration behavior, credits and charges. Immediate changes bill only the difference. Each credit gets its own credit invoice with a clear origin, a full audit trail and webhook notifications, supporting auditable proration records. Missing for 10: documented proration formulas or partial-period calculation examples, evidence that invoice line items reconcile to the penny, and independent or hands-on corroboration of proration accuracy.
